title: Reversing motor starter
goal: A reader can trace both motor directions, identify each holding branch, and verify the stop, overload, and opposite-coil interlocks.

rubric.must: Two separate rungs terminate in coils labelled Forward and Reverse respectively.
Both Stop contacts, both Overload contacts, and both opposite-direction interlock contacts have visible normally-closed diagonal marks.
FwdStart and the Forward holding contact occupy separate parallel paths with visible split and rejoin connections.
RevStart and the Reverse holding contact occupy separate parallel paths with visible split and rejoin connections.
The Forward coil rung has a series normally-closed Reverse contact, and the Reverse coil rung has a series normally-closed Forward contact, outside their holding branches.
Each rung passes through Stop and Overload before splitting into the start and holding paths, with no branch bypassing either protection contact.
Every contact and coil label is readable and unambiguously attached to its own symbol.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all seven rules, while the picture shares one Stop and one Overload contact across both control paths instead of providing the required pair on each separate rung.
